reviews.title: Editors’ Choice
reviews.review: The long-awaited moment for Toca Boca fans has arrived. Toca Boca World, the newest edition to the popular series, brings together all the Toca Life apps, letting your beloved characters from different apps mingle in one beautiful world. And this unique world keeps growing: The app continually updates with new areas to explore and characters to meet.
